name: LG H&H

figures.source: DART (FSS) annual filing — consolidated revenue; includes non-BPC Home & Daily Beauty and beverage lines, so it overstates the BPC position
korea.json shares — share of summed revenue for the 2 listed KR brand owners (base KRW 10.608tn); flagged non_pure_play. NOT a market share

corridor_involvement: Present in India by assortment rather than by announced entry. Its The Face Shop is the deepest K-brand on the Blinkit q-commerce capture (2026-07-23) at 21 SKUs — Rice Water line, sheet masks from Rs90 up to cleansers and kits at Rs1,349, all in stock — and The Face Shop also appears in Flipkart's 2025 international K-beauty portfolio and on Amazon India. No launch event for LG H&H is recorded in corridor.yaml; it arrived through channel depth, not exclusives.
read: The larger of Korea's two listed brand owners by revenue (KRW 6.355tn, 2025, DART) but the one moving backwards: reported -6.7% YoY with operating profit down 62.8% to KRW 170.7bn. Read the share figure carefully — 59.9% is share of a two-company revenue base that includes LG H&H's non-BPC lines, not a market share, and the repo's own qualifier says so. The India-relevant point is that LG H&H demonstrates the alternative corridor route to AmorePacific's exclusive-partnership model: mature local supply into mass q-commerce at Rs90-1,349 price points, which is precisely the masstige-and-below band an import-led entrant will struggle to reach.
